description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Colts waived Blake Freeland.
items.impact: Freeland missed all of last season with a fracture in his right leg.
items.title: Blake Freeland waived by Colts

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants released OL Evan Neal.
items.impact: Neal had just signed a new one-year deal with the Giants this offseason. He'll now seek a fresh start after not making the 53-man roster.
items.title: Evan Neal released by Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers released WR KhaDarel Hodge.
items.impact: Hodge could end up back on the practice squad with San Francisco.
items.title: KhaDarel Hodge released by 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders placed RB Jeremy McNichols on injured reserve.
items.impact: McNichols will miss at least the first four weeks of the season due to a quad issue.
items.title: Jeremy McNichols (quad) placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins waived RB Jarquez Hunter.
items.impact: Hunter was just acquired in a trade by Miami earlier this week. He could return to the Dolphins practice squad if he clears waivers.
items.title: Jarquez Hunter waived by Dolphins

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Falcons released RB Tyler Goodson.
items.impact: Goodson was competing for a depth role in the Falcons backfield. He could land another opportunity on a practice squad.
items.title: Tyler Goodson released by Falcons

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Vikings waived Jermar Jefferson with an injury designation.
items.impact: If he clears waivers, Jefferson will revert to the Vikings' injured reserve list.
items.title: Jermar Jefferson waived by Vikings

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Steelers activated Joey Porter Jr. from the active/PUP list.
items.impact: Porter missed all of training camp on the PUP list with a back injury. He had been seeking a new contract.
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (back) activated from PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Saints placed Jordyn Tyson on injured reserve.
items.impact: Tyson is expected to miss roughly two months with a hamstring injury. He has been dealing with hamstring issues since college at Arizona State.
items.title: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Steelers released RB Travis Homer.
items.impact: Homer was competing for a depth role in the Steelers backfield. He'll seek another opportunity heading into the season.
items.title: Travis Homer released by Steelers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bears released RB Salvon Ahmed.
items.impact: Ahmed missed all of last season with an ankle injury. He'll seek another opportunity in a depth role heading into the season.
items.title: Salvon Ahmed released by Bears

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jaguars released RB DeeJay Dallas.
items.impact: Dallas was competing for a depth role in the Jaguars backfield. He'll figure to seek another opportunity heading into the season.
items.title: DeeJay Dallas released by Jaguars

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bears placed DL Shemar Turner on the reserve/physically unable to perform list with a calf injury.
items.impact: Turner will miss at least the first four games of the regular season for Chicago.
items.title: Shemar Turner placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bears placed LB Noah Sewell on the PUP list.
items.impact: Sewell will miss at least the first four games of the regular season for Chicago.
items.title: Noah Sewell (Achilles) placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bears placed DB Kyler Gordon on the reserve/physically unable to perform list with a calf injury.
items.impact: Gordon will miss at least the first four games of the regular season for Chicago.
items.title: Kyler Gordon placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Eagles released WR Quez Watkins.
items.impact: Watkins has not appeared in a regular season game since 2023. He will seek a depth role with another team.
items.title: Quez Watkins released by Eagles

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: J.J. McCarthy has made the Vikings' initial 53-man roster.
items.impact: There was some speculation that McCarthy might be left off the initial roster. Those turned out to not be true as he officially makes it. He'll be behind Kyler Murray and potentially Carson Wentz as well to open the season.
items.title: J.J. McCarthy makes Vikings 53-man roster

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans waived WR Lewis Bond.
items.impact: Bond could land back on the Texans practice squad if he clears waivers.
items.title: Lewis Bond waived by Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Buccaneers released EDGE Chris Braswell.
items.impact: Braswell will look to land another opportunity in a depth role heading into the season.
items.title: Chris Braswell released by Bucs

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Saints placed Mason Tipton on the reserve/PUP list.
items.impact: Tipton is still working his way back from a groin issue that landed him on injured reserve late last year. He will miss at least the first four games of the season.
items.title: Mason Tipton placed on reserve/PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots acquired OT Walter Rouse from the Vikings.
items.impact: Rouse will add depth on the offensive line for New England.
items.title: Walter Rouse traded to Patriots

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Lions released WR Greg Dortch.
items.impact: Dortch spent the past several seasons in a depth role with the Cardinals. He'll seek a similar role with another team heading into Week 1.
items.title: Greg Dortch released by Lions

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants waived WR Jalin Hyatt.
items.impact: Hyatt has not been able to make the jump from college to the NFL. He will seek a depth role with another team heading into the season.
items.title: Jalin Hyatt waived by Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers placed Isaac Guerendo to the reserve/PUP list.
items.impact: Guerendo is working his way back from a pec injury. He will miss at least the first four weeks of the season.
items.title: Isaac Guerendo placed on reserve/PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cardinals placed RB James Conner on injured reserve/designated to return.
items.impact: Conner had been working his way back to during training camp. He will miss at least the first four games of the regular season.
items.title: James Conner (foot) placed on injured reserve/designated to return

title: Fantasy Player News
